classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Warriors are masters of physical combat who rely on overwhelming strength, martial discipline, and relentless aggression. They excel at dealing damage, enduring punishment, and controlling the battlefield through sheer force.

subclasses.name: Berserker
subclasses.description: A ferocious combatant who channels fury into devastating attacks.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: A disciplined martial warrior who excels through physical prowess and weapon mastery.

subclasses.name: Wildheart
subclasses.description: A warrior who draws upon primal instincts and the power of nature.
